//: The netcode's TypeScript modules. net.js itself stays hand-written plain JS (the page's inline script imports it raw and the loopback tests drive it in node), but everything ADDED to this package is TypeScript under src/, compiled to committed JS in build/, which is what the page's import map serves and what the app resolves through the package's exports. Committed for the same reason page/build is: GitHub Pages serves this repo as it stands and a push is the whole deploy, so the pre-commit hook and CI rebuild and refuse a drifted artefact. Unlike page/build this output is NOT minified: it ships beside net.js and engine.js, which ship annotated, and a second minify pipeline would buy nothing but a second thing to break. Strict flags match page/tsconfig.json.
